text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition points nowhere useful: the candidate chosen was also a woman, so an all-female panel can't readily be read as bias against women. Raising it would likely read as grievance-hunting and damage your standing without advancing your case.

The real signal is elsewhere. "Excellent client relationships" against your deeper technical and project-leadership record suggests they weighted business development — a common and legitimate priority for a group head role. That may be a genuine gap in your profile, or poorly communicated criteria.

Do chase the written explanation. Send a polite follow-up to HR, reference your original date, and ask specifically what distinguished the appointee. That's the useful fight.
